tuples.subject: penal_charges
tuples.special_circumstance: fresh loans availed from 2024-04-01 onwards; for existing loans, switchover on the next review/renewal date falling on or after 2024-04-01 but not later than 2024-06-30
tuples.quote: REs shall ensure that the instructions are implemented in respect of all the fresh loans availed from April 1, 2024 onwards. In the case of existing loans, the switchover to new penal charges regime shall be ensured on the next review/ renewal date falling on or after April 1, 2024, but not later than June 30, 2024.
